purpose: Provision the two fixed production LUKS2 vaults and satisfy recovery and restart gates before the already-implemented guarded data cutover.

header_custody_executor.execution_boundary: existing backup-worker container with its private R2 credential mount

docker_restart_gate.control: Docker ExecStartPre invokes the Docker-independent, read-only status --require-host-ready check on every daemon start.
docker_restart_gate.missing_mapper_or_mount_behavior: docker.service fails closed before the daemon starts
docker_restart_gate.host_gate_checks: exact mappers, LUKS activity, ext4 labels, mount sources, mount options, and all eleven subpaths
docker_restart_gate.post_boot_recovery: operator re-materializes the external active bundle into the fixed tmpfs root, runs the guarded unlock command while Docker is stopped, removes the tmpfs bundle, then starts Docker through this host gate

production_gate_order: fresh encrypted R2 backup and independent restore pass within 3600 seconds
active and recovery key bundles exist as distinct external custody items outside server and R2
owner authorization and bounded maintenance window are current
vault plan and apply succeed while all production services remain untouched
both LUKS2 header backups are independently uploaded and read-back verified off-host
both recovery keys open their respective vaults and active keys reopen them
Docker restart gate is installed and verified
FR-06B3B guarded cutover stops at candidate_started_admission_closed
Docker daemon restart and host boot recovery pass while admission remains closed
health, permissions, backup, governed build, and p95 regression at or below 15 percent pass
a new independent owner decision is required before opening admission

failure_policy.before_success_receipt: Remove only Docker volumes, mounts, mappers, and image files newly created by the failed invocation.
failure_policy.after_success_receipt: Retain encrypted images and evidence; use FR-06B3B rollback for data-path rollback and do not delete plaintext legacy volumes.

next_action: Merge this protected source batch, then create fresh production recovery and external-custody evidence before provisioning. Do not run the guarded data cutover until every preceding gate is fresh and verified.
